context.body: Divine reputation among nations and inward human change belong to the same restoration.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The Lord GOD says restoration is not for Israel’s sake, sanctifies the profaned name, gathers, cleanses, gives a new heart and Spirit, and produces obedience.
observations.label: God acts for the holy name and renews Israel: action

observations.body: Israel is restored and then remembers its ways with shame.
observations.label: God acts for the holy name and renews Israel: response

observations.body: not for your sake · holy name · clean water · new heart · my Spirit
observations.label: Words in Ezekiel 36:22–32

payload.posture: Read Ezekiel 36:22–32 as the prophetic voice evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage denies Israel’s merit without depicting restored people as passive after renewal.
payload.title: God acts for the holy name and renews Israel
